title: Descant Recorder
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Creative Arts; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Low C needs every hole covered gently. Fingerings are described in words.

skills.key_step: The child says how to hold and play: left hand on top, right below, finger pads seal holes, gentle breath (softest for low notes), tongue each note.
steps: Blow gently; softer for low notes.

board.do: One hole not sealed for low C.

misconceptions.ask: How should you blow into the recorder?
misconceptions.repair: Blow hard and gently and listen to the squeak.

misconceptions.ask: How should the finger pads cover the holes?
misconceptions.repair: Cover a hole partly and fully and compare.

misconceptions.ask: Which hand is on the top holes?
misconceptions.repair: Hold a recorder and check which hand is on top.

misconceptions.ask: How should you blow for low C?
misconceptions.repair: Play low C gently and then hard; hear the squeak.

checks.question: Which hand goes at the top of the recorder?
Low notes need harder or gentler breath?
